Made with FFmpeg 9.0.2 (libvorbis, libopus, libmp3lame 3.100, FFmpeg's FLAC
encoder) from

  T='aevalsrc=if(gte(t\,0.5)\,0.5*sin(2*PI*440*t)\,0.1*sin(2*PI*220*t)):s=8000:c=mono:d=1'

cover.png:  ffmpeg -f lavfi -i 'color=c=0x3060a0:s=16x16:d=1' -frames:v 1 cover.png
vorbis.ogg: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a libvorbis -q:a 0 -metadata METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE=$P -page_duration 100000 vorbis.ogg
opus.ogg:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a libopus -b:a 12k -metadata METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE=$P -page_duration 100000 opus.ogg
flac.oga:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a flac -frame_size 1024 -page_duration 100000 flac.oga
tone.flac:  ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -i cover.png -map 0 -map 1 -c:a flac -frame_size 1024 -c:v png -disposition:v attached_pic tone.flac
flac.mp4:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a flac -frame_size 1024 flac.mp4
flac.mka:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a flac -frame_size 1024 flac.mka
tone.mp3:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -i cover.png -map 0 -map 1 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 16k -c:v png -disposition:v attached_pic -id3v2_version 3 tone.mp3
cbr.mp3:    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "$T" -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 16k -write_xing 0 -id3v2_version 0 cbr.mp3
back.png:   ffmpeg -f lavfi -i 'color=c=0xa03060:s=16x16:d=1' -frames:v 1 back.png
covers.mka: ffmpeg -i flac.mka -t 0.2 -attach notes.txt -metadata:s:t:0 mimetype=text/plain \
                   -attach back.png -metadata:s:t:1 mimetype=image/png \
                   -attach cover.png -metadata:s:t:2 mimetype=image/png -c copy covers.mka
back-cover.mka: the same without cover.png

notes.txt is the 12 bytes "liner notes\n".

$P is the base64 of a FLAC PICTURE block (front cover, image/png, 16x16x24)
holding cover.png. tone.flac had FFmpeg's 8 KiB PADDING block removed and the
last remaining metadata block flagged last.
